newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline pulled higher by crude gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline pulled higher by crude gains.

text.p: NWE gasoline pushed higher on Wednesday in a busy market after strong gains in crude futures gave the market a more positive tone, traders said.
"It's been very busy. I'd sold my first barge of the day by 0815," said one trader.
Eurograde winter spec barges were done early at $214 fob ARA but traders said later offers were as high as $216.
Summer specification Eurograde barges were done at $213, $214 and $215 fob ARA in early trade. Offers were heard around $217 fob ARA.
Regular barges were reported to have traded at $208.
Traders attributed the gains to stronger crude late on Tuesday.
"The market's being waiting for some positive price action," said one trader. "With the U.S. driving season approaching we ought to start seeing a bit more business."
